segments.text: Confession of Faith twenty-five, paragraph five
The purest churches under heaven are subject both to mixture and error; and some have so degenerated, as to become no churches of Christ, but synagogues of Satan.
Nevertheless, there shall be always a church on earth, to worship God according to his will.
Are all they saved who hear the gospel, and live in the church
All that hear the gospel, and live in the visible church, are not saved; but they only who are true members of the church invisible.
